schema_diagnosis.initial_rejections: Provider rejected overlapping integer/number union, then same-primitive string union. Both were strict-schema incompatibilities, not clause interpretation errors.
schema_diagnosis.fix: Lossless union canonicalization: number covers integer; string enums/patterns merged as a regex union. Disjoint node oneOf is expressed as anyOf; all validators unchanged. Required output property named title is preserved.
